title: Relative Clauses in the Middle of Sentences

instruction.text: Choose the most suitable relative clause to complete the sentence.

atoms.a: ssml: Kayla <break time='500ms'/> just started secondary school.
atoms.b: Kayla, ((++who_is_eleven which_is_green that_is_nearby)), just started secondary school.

atoms.a: ssml: My home town, <break time='500ms'/> is my favourite place.
atoms.b: My home town, ((++which_is_very_small whose_dog_is_cute who_is_tall)), is my favourite place.

atoms.a: ssml: Tennis <break time='500ms'/> is the best sport.
atoms.b: Tennis, ((++which_I_play_every_week who_is_my_best_friend when_I_was_small)), is the best sport.

atoms.a: ssml: Frankie, <break time='500ms'/> is my new best friend.
atoms.b: Frankie, ((++who_I_know_from_school that_I_used_today when_it_was_sunny)), is my new best friend.

atoms.a: ssml: The burger <break time='500ms'/> was filled with cheese.
atoms.b: The burger, ((++which_was_so_unhealthy whose_hair_is_curly who_is_from_Scotland)), was filled with cheese

instruction.text: Choose the sentence where the relative clause is in the correct place.

b: ++My brother, whose favourite subject is maths, wants to be an engineer when he grows up.
My brother wants to be an engineer when he grows up, whose favourite subject is maths.
++Jamie, who lives in Spain, came to visit us last week.
Jamie came to visit us last week, who lives in Spain.
++Dogs have very soft fur, which is nice to stroke.
Dogs, which is very nice to stroke, have soft fur.
++Tamara, who has an older brother, invited me to her party.
Tamara invited me to her party, who has an older brother.
